握草草草！这丫的要吃她啊！

老子的剑呢？

老子要砍死它！

就在时笙找剑的时候，一抹冰凉的柔软从指尖扫过，她浑身颤了颤，诡异的看向丧尸。

他正舔着她的指尖，眉头微微皱着，似乎觉得不好吃。

“嗬嗬！”

“？？”不懂，说人话。

“嗬嗬！！”丧尸将她的手拉到她面前，有些焦躁的吼着。

时笙看了看自己的手。

嗯，很干净很漂亮，真是棒棒哒。

“嗬嗬！”

丧尸伸出手指，对着她的食指戳了戳，僵滞的眸子里闪现出期待和渴望。

时笙也拿着手指戳了戳了他。

干什么？

戳一下能把本宝宝戳死吗？

因为不知道如何表达，丧尸焦躁的绕着时笙转了两圈，最后一溜烟的跑了。

时笙：“……”

这是什么新玩法？

丧尸的世界，本宝宝不懂啊！

时笙这才观察自己所在的地方，是一处不大的山洞，肯定不可能是她掉进山洞的，因为上面是实心的。

所以是那只丧尸把她弄进来的？

丧尸智商都这么高了？

真是可怕！

她的背包和铁剑都放在不远的角落，估计也是丧尸捡回来的。白虎趴在旁边睡着了，她叫了好几声都没叫醒，好在看上去挺正常的，不知道是不是要觉醒异能了。

动物也会觉醒异能，只是概率比人类低多了。

背包里面的东西都还在，食物被水泡过，肯定是不能吃了。

戚明雪啊！

竟然敢暗算她……

时笙收拾东西，走出山洞，顿时傻眼了。

为毛这个山洞是开在悬崖上的啊草？

那只丧尸是会飞吗？

丧尸会不会飞时笙不知道，但是她很快就知道那只丧尸是怎么上来的了，丫的这货会空间瞬移。

他就那么突兀的出现在她旁边，要不是她定力好，肯定早就吓得掉悬崖去了。

“嗬嗬！”丧尸将手中的白色小花递给时笙，指了指她的手指，又指了指花。

Hold the grass!This girl wants to eat her!

Where is my sword?

I want to chop it to death!

Just when Shi Sheng was looking for the sword, a touch of cold softness swept across her fingertips. She trembled all over and looked at the zombies strangely.

He was licking her fingertips, frowning slightly, as if he didn't feel it tasted good.

"Ho ho!"

"??" I don't understand, speaking in human language.

"Ho ho!!" The zombie pulled her hand in front of her and shouted anxiously.

Shi Sheng looked at his hands.

Well, it's very clean and beautiful. It's great.

"Ho ho!"

The zombie stretched out his finger and poked her index finger, expectation and desire flashing in his dull eyes.

Shi Sheng also poked him with his finger.

What to do?

Can a poke kill this baby?

Because he didn't know how to express it, the zombie anxiously circled Shi Sheng twice, and finally ran away.

Shi Sheng: "..."

What new way is this?

I don’t understand the world of zombies!

Shi Sheng then observed where she was. It was a small cave. It was definitely impossible for her to fall into the cave, because the top was solid.

So it was the zombie that brought her in?

Do zombies have such high IQs?

How terrible!

Her backpack and iron sword were placed in a corner not far away, and they were probably picked up by zombies.Bai Hu fell asleep lying next to her. She screamed several times but didn't wake her up. Fortunately, she seemed to be quite normal. I wonder if she is about to awaken her powers.

Animals can also awaken supernatural powers, but the probability is much lower than that of humans.

Everything in the backpack was still there, but the food had been soaked in water and was definitely inedible.

Qi Mingxue!

How dare you plot against her...

Shi Sheng packed up his things and walked out of the cave, and was immediately dumbfounded.

Why is this cave opened on a cliff?

Can that zombie fly?

Shi Sheng didn't know if zombies could fly, but she soon knew how the zombie came up. Damn it, that guy could teleport through space.

He appeared next to her so suddenly. If she hadn't been so calm, she would have been so frightened that she fell off the cliff.

"Ho ho!" The zombie handed the small white flower in his hand to Shi Sheng, pointed to her finger, and then pointed to the flower.
